svg.text: HOW TO MAKE IT AND HOW IT FITS

text.font-family: IBM Plex Sans, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: Pipe: DN25 (1 in) galvanized, 33.7 x 3.2 mm, cut square to 2,290 mm.

text.font-family: IBM Plex Sans, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: Base plate: 200 x 200 x 10 mm steel; four 12 mm holes on a 150 mm

text.font-family: IBM Plex Sans, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: square (75 mm each way from the centre) for M10 anchors.

text.font-family: IBM Plex Sans, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: Gussets: four 6 mm plates, triangles 60 mm along the plate and 78 mm

text.font-family: IBM Plex Sans, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: up the pipe face, one on each side, in line with the plate edges.

text.font-family: IBM Plex Sans, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: Stay lug: 6 mm plate 68 x 50 mm from the pipe face, on the bin side, centred

text.font-family: IBM Plex Sans, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: 1,580 mm above the underside of the base plate, square to the wall;

text.font-family: IBM Plex Sans, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: two 11 mm holes 42 and 69 mm from the pipe axis, 2 mm below its middle.

text.font-family: IBM Plex Sans, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: Grind the zinc off 25 mm round every weld first; weld in open air.

text.font-family: IBM Plex Sans, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: Fillet weld the pipe all round to the plate centre, gussets and lug

text.font-family: IBM Plex Sans, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: both sides. Paint the welds and the plate with zinc-rich paint.

text.font-family: IBM Plex Sans, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: Fit: four M10 anchors into the pad; stay to the lug; clamps on the pipe.

text.font-family: IBM Plex Sans, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: Check: the pipe stands square to the plate within 1 mm per 300 mm.
